hooks.name: doc-file-warning
hooks.description:
Warn before creating documentation files to avoid unnecessary documentation

Migration note: Tool categories were converted to the tool-name matcher `^(fs_write|fs_append|str_replace|delete_file|code)$`, reconstructed from the built-in tool list. Confirm it covers the tools you meant, then enable the hook.

action.prompt:
You are about to create or modify a file. If this is a documentation file (README, CHANGELOG, docs/, etc.) that was not explicitly requested by the user, consider whether it's truly necessary. Documentation should be created only when:

1. Explicitly requested by the user
2. Required for project setup or usage
3. Part of a formal specification or requirement

If you're creating documentation that wasn't requested, briefly explain why it's necessary or skip it. Proceed with the write operation if appropriate.
